description: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart comparing response outcomes for two ambiguity conditions, with the outer ring labeled “Ambiguity 1” and the inner ring labeled “Ambiguity 2 (Inner),” each divided into three categories for deception status. There are three slices per ring (six slices total across both rings): “Deceived” shown in red, “Partially” shown in yellow, and “Not Deceived” shown in green. In the outer ring (Ambiguity 1), the red “Deceived” slice is labeled 67.6%, the yellow “Partially” slice is labeled 23.5%, and the green “Not Deceived” slice is labeled 8.8%. In the inner ring (Ambiguity 2), the red “Deceived” slice is labeled 57.9%, the yellow “Partially” slice is labeled 31.6%, and the green “Not Deceived” slice is labeled 10.5%. Percentage labels are printed directly on the slices, and two legends appear on the right identifying the color-to-category mapping for each ring; no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments appear arranged consistently by category around the circle.
